setup.title: Setup Provider
setup.description: Choose how to connect {{provider}} and verify the connection.

guide.codex: Use Auto for ChatGPT/Codex subscription login, or switch to API key mode.
guide.claude: Install and log in to Claude CLI, then test connection.
guide.gemini: Use Gemini API key mode for direct usage fetch.
guide.kiro: Install Kiro CLI in your host/WSL environment.
guide.copilot: Use GitHub auth token (or gh hosts.yml token) for Copilot usage API.

guide.jetbrains: No token required. AIGauge reads JetBrains local quota files automatically.
guide.default: Configure provider credential and test connection.
